title: license create
description: What nw-license license create answers with -o json once it has signed a license and written it to a new file: the file and the license it signed, so the owner sees what was signed and where it went before passing the file on (ADR-L7, L8, L9). Printed only after the file is written; a refusal writes nothing and is an error instead.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/license/app/v1: the form of nw-license's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the license files they describe.

kind.description: Always LicenseCreate, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always license, nw-license's product ID, since only nw-license gives this answer (ADR-L7).

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: The file written and the license signed into it: file, then the payload's own fields, each meaning what license-payload.schema.json says (their one home), with its rules for each kind, such as a trial key naming no products (ADR-L9). No other field. A payload field nw-license adds reaches LicenseCreate only in a new contract version (CT-RULE-1), so license/v1 stays fixed.

file.description: The license file written, as the command was given it, so relative to the folder it ran in when given so; the owner passes this file on and the person adds it with <app> license add (ADR-L8).
